name: 砚池
basis: outline: OSM reflecting pool 砚池 (about 500 m2, x 37..64, y -130..-108 in the twin frame); water level and basin depth estimated; photographs campus_yanchi.jpg and wenhua_yanchi-800.jpg show rock edging, a rockery with a curved cascade from a raised round basin, an upright stone inscribed 砚池 in red, coconut palms and surrounding corridor buildings
rockery_basis: rockery and raised round cascade basin with a curved weir (wenhua_yanchi); their position in the pond and the stones are invented

stone.basis: upright stone about 2.6 m high with the red vertical inscription 砚池 at the pond edge (campus_yanchi, wenhua_yanchi); position on the shore estimated

palms.basis: tall leaning coconut palms round the pond (campus_yanchi, wenhua_yanchi); number and positions invented
